# PhotoHouse product roadmap / 产品路线图

25 November 2026 · reviewed snapshot / 2026 年 11 月 25 日 · 回顾快照

Reviewed integration record / 部署与集成回顾记录

The bilingual roadmap and fullscreen viewer have Windows delivery records. Later audit improvements have local source checks. Household use, native Search relevance and installed-client acceptance remain open. / 双语路线图与全屏浏览器已有 Windows 交付记录。之后的审计改进已完成本地源码检查。家庭实际使用、本机搜索相关性以及已安装客户端的验收仍待完成。

This is a dated product record, not a live health check. / 这是有日期的产品记录，不是实时健康检查。

## Priorities / 优先方向

### Make Search refinement conversational / 让搜索条件能够自然逐轮细化

Understand dates, retain the active filters across follow-up questions, and show what is actually being searched. / 理解日期表达，保留追问中的现有筛选条件，并清楚展示实际查找范围。

**Done when / 完成标准:** A family member can find photos, narrow by person/date/place, change a condition and open a result without starting over. / 家人能够查找照片，按人物／日期／地点逐步缩小范围，修改条件并打开结果，无需反复从头描述。

### Make Jude useful across conversations / 让小贾在多轮对话中真正好用

Find photos, refine conditions and explain results without losing scope or pretending an action succeeded. / 查找照片、逐轮细化条件、解释结果，同时保留范围约束，不把失败说成成功。

**Done when / 完成标准:** A household can continue a search, inspect the applied conditions, reopen a result and cancel uncertain work clearly. / 家人可以继续查找、查看已生效条件、重新打开结果，并清楚地取消状态不明的请求。

### Turn contributions into reviewable memories / 把家庭素材整理成可审阅的记忆

Preserve original words while proposing grounded corrections, readable stories and meaningful memory groups. / 保留原始表达，同时提供有依据的纠错、可读的故事与有意义的记忆分组。

**Done when / 完成标准:** Authors can compare sources and drafts, resolve uncertainty and explicitly adopt changes; optional cloud work remains opt-in. / 作者能对照原始素材与草稿、处理不确定信息并明确采纳修改；可选云端处理始终需要主动同意。
